definition: The process of finding a formula for the gradient of a curve from its equation; each term $ax^n$ becomes $nax^{n-1}$.
The result of differentiating, written $\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}$, which gives the gradient of the curve at any value of $x$.
How steep a curve is at one point, equal to the gradient of the tangent drawn at that point.
A point on a curve where the gradient is zero, so $\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x} = 0$ and the tangent is horizontal; it can be a maximum or a minimum.
